_about: apex-terminal complete design token inventory. Names match the engine DTCG schemas (colorscheme.schema.json + stylesystem.schema.json) for round-trip fidelity. Import with Tokens Studio → Export to Figma Variables. Two color modes (Aperture / Meridien) and two dimension modes (Aperture / Meridien) demonstrate the two-axis theme system.

_modes._comment: Two-axis system. Color axis = ColorScheme (palette only). Dimension axis = StyleSystem (sizes, spacing, behaviors). In Tokens Studio: put 'color.*' and 'colorExtended.*' in one collection named 'ColorScheme' with modes 'Aperture' and 'Meridien'. Put all other groups in a second collection named 'StyleSystem' with modes 'Aperture' and 'Meridien'. Switching a Figma mode == switching a theme axis in the running app.

color._comment_semantics: Extended semantic palette (S1). Optional — when absent, resolved_*() falls back to bull/bear/warn.

panel_footer_card.description: Pinned panel footer renders as elevated rounded card. Aperture signature. DTCG key: chrome.panel_footer_card

panel_footer_radius.description: Corner radius of pinned footer card (px). Aperture: 10px. DTCG key: chrome.panel_footer_radius

chromeMeridien._comment: Meridien chrome overrides — tall toolbar, sharp edges, flush contiguous chrome, single row.

textStyle._comment: Composite TEXT STYLES (Figma text styles — not variables). Bind layer text to these composites. Tokens Studio 'typography' type. Aperture values.

label.description: Tab labels, nav labels. Uses typography.size_md.

label_tracked.description: Tracked section / eyebrow label. Uses size_section_label + label_tracking.

cell_upper.description: Table column headers — mono uppercase tracked.

display_sm.description: Small display / card hero value. Uses size_xl.

display_lg.description: Large display hero price — tight negative tracking.

effectStyle._comment: EFFECT STYLES (Figma effect styles — not variables). Bind layer effects to these. Shadow color resolves from color.shadow at render time. Tokens Studio 'boxShadow' type.

card.description: Subtle card lift — use on elevated panel/card layers.
